programs.name: 中國語言文學與教學文學碩士 Master of Arts in Chinese Language, Literature and Teaching

academic.text: Hold a recognised bachelor's degree, meeting the University's general admission requirements for postgraduate programmes.

prerequisites.text: Meet the Chinese oral and written expression requirement: hold an honours degree from a local Hong Kong, mainland or overseas university whose medium of instruction is Chinese, or meet one of the listed Chinese proficiency requirements.
prerequisites.quote: 申請人亦須符合中文口語及書面表達能力要求。凡持有香港本地、內地或海外大學頒授之榮譽學位，且該校教學語言為中文者；或符合下列其中一項中文能力要求者：

prerequisites.text: HKDSE Chinese Language Level 4 or above.
prerequisites.quote: 香港中學文憑考試（HKDSE）中文科達第四級或以上；

prerequisites.text: HKCEE Chinese Language Grade D or above.
prerequisites.quote: 香港中學會考中文科成績達D級或以上；

prerequisites.text: IB Chinese Standard and Higher Level examination Level 5 or above.
prerequisites.quote: 國際文憑課程中文科標準及高級程度考試達5級或以上；

prerequisites.text: IB Chinese Higher Level examination Level 6 or above.
prerequisites.quote: 國際文憑課程中文科高級程度考試達6級或以上；

prerequisites.text: HSK Level 6 with a total score of 240 or above.
prerequisites.quote: 漢語水平考試（HSK）六級總分達240分或以上；

prerequisites.text: National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao) Chinese Language 110 marks or above.
prerequisites.quote: 普通高等學校招生全國統一考試語文達110分或以上；或

prerequisites.text: Other equivalent qualifications.
prerequisites.quote: 具備其他同等資歷。

ielts.quote: Overall score 6.0 in International English Language Testing System (IELTS) (Academic), with no subtest score lower than 5.5;

toefl.text: Score 550 on the paper-based test or 80 on the internet-based test.
toefl.quote: Score 550 (Paper-based test) or 80 (Internet-based test) in TOEFL;

academic.text: Graduated from a recognised university with a bachelor's degree in finance, FinTech, management, psychology, law, economics, business or other related areas.

prerequisites.quote: Students without prior study in Economics/Finance or FinTech must pass the non-credit-bearing bridging course(s) "Economics and Finance for FinTech" and/or "Cryptography and Blockchain" before the programme starts.

ielts.quote: Overall score 6.0 in International English Language Testing System (IELTS) (Academic), with no subtest score lower than 5.5;

Applicants with honours degrees from local or mainland universities where the teaching medium is Chinese; or obtained Level 3 or above in Chinese Language in the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination (HKDSE); or other evidence of Chinese language proficiency.
